united_earth_is_1: Hariho abantu benshi bashaka gukiza umubumbe wacu. Amashyirahamwe atabarika, amashyirahamwe, ibigo nabantu bonyine. Ariko ntituzi undi.
united_earth_is_3: Tugomba guhuza hamwe kugirango twerekane uburyo urugendo rwacu rukomeye. Niba tuzi umubare, dushobora gufasha abantu guhindura imyumvire yabo ku bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere kugira ubutwari n'icyizere. Turashobora guha abantu imbaraga zo gutangiza ingamba zabo zo kurengera ikirere. Gusa hamwe dushobora guhindura isi tugakiza ikirere!
united_earth_is_4: Hindura isi wiyandikishije kurubuga rwacu! Turi benshi!
united_earth_is_5: Turagutumiye cyane gusangira aya makuru n'inshuti, abafatanyabikorwa ndetse n'abo tuziranye.

united_earth_is_8: Umushinga wo kwitabira ecolabel yo muri Otirishiya
about_us_2: Niba twerekanye uko turi, dushobora gufasha abantu guhindura imyumvire yabo ku bijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere kuva kwiheba kugera ku butwari no kwigirira icyizere. Turashobora guha abantu imbaraga zo gutangiza ingamba zabo zo kurengera ikirere.
about_us_3: Ariko ikiruta byose: Ntabwo twakongera kumva twenyine kandi nta mbaraga dufite. Byaduhuza. Byaduha ibyiringiro, imbaraga, ubutwari nicyizere. Twakumva duhujwe kwisi yose - dukiza umubumbe wacu kandi tugakora ejo hazaza heza.
about_us_4: Intego yacu ni uguha abantu ubutwari, icyizere n'imbaraga zo gutangiza ingamba zabo bwite zo kurengera ikirere.
about_us_5: Icyitonderwa: Nta ntambara kubera ibitekerezo bitandukanye - kujijuka, ntabwo agahato gakwiye kutubera ishingiro ryo kurinda isi yacu.
about_us_6: Abantu 100, bose bavuga indimi zitandukanye, batonda umurongo mubwato bugana ku isoko. Hafi ya bose mubwato bazi ibintu biteye akaga. Ariko hafi ya bose batekereza ko ariwe wenyine ubizi. Abantu bose baratekereza bati: "Nakora iki?" "Gutonda umurongo mu kindi cyerekezo ntacyo bimaze!" Kandi buriwese yishora mumyitwarire isanzwe ya kera. Byagenda bite mugihe gitunguranye abantu bose bamenyanye - bazi ko abantu bose bashaka gusubira inyuma kandi ko bashobora kuvugana?
about_us_8: United-Earth2025 - umushinga wo kwitabira ecolabel yo muri Otirishiya.
about_us_9: Urubuga hamwe nimbuga nkoranyambaga bihujwe bikozwe nabanyeshuri 200 nabarimu mwishuri rya Otirishiya.
about_us_10: Umushinga wakozwe nkumushinga wo kwitabira ecolabel yo muri Otirishiya. Ibintu byose byurubuga byakozwe nkumushinga wishuri.
about_us_11: Turashobora gukurikiza amadini atandukanye, tugatandukana mumyaka n'inkomoko, ariko twese turashaka gukiza umubumbe wacu. Abitabiriye amahugurwa bose ni abakorerabushake.

ws_saving_earth_text: Leta ya umubumbe wacu igenda butangaje , nko unehmende amapfa, imyuzure, ibihuhusi na imiyaga, anyuranye ya amabati munini ice, izamuka nzego nyanja , gutwika amashyamba, uburozi imigezi n'ibiyaga, imyanda misozi ku gihugu no mu nyanja - na ibihumbi inyamaswa bicika - n'ibimera ubwoko . umubumbe wacu ni ku mupaka wa ubushobozi bwayo Anglo- a biterwa. Turashaka gukiza umubumbe wacu bitarenze .
ws_peace_text: Intego yacu nukubana mumahoro kubantu bose nabantu kwisi. Turi gufashanya no gufashanya. Turi guhagarara kwemerwa kwivuza no kubaha n gutunganya . Twumva ibyo abandi bakeneye. Turi mu gukemura amakimbirane mu mahoro. Turi ku gutabara ya imibabaro no kubabara. Kandi ni kubera a n fr ie dvollen ukwiriranya bose r mahanga .
ws_forests_text: Tugomba kurinda amashyamba yacu no kurinda inyanja. Turi kurinda imigezi n'ibiyaga byacu. Tugomba kubungabunga ikirere cyacu no kugira isuku hasi. Kandi kubona isano hagati bose biremwa bizima abantu, inyamaswa n n'ibimera. Niba amashyamba yacu ninyanja bipfuye, natwe tuzapfa. Ntakintu kibaho cyigenga.
ws_science_text: Turi kubumenyi nubushakashatsi bukorera abantu no kuri iyi si. Mu n'ubuhinga, mu siyansi, mu social - na R e , chtswissenschaften mu gihugu - n'amashyamba, imiti no mu bushakashatsi no mu siyansi muri rusange. Gusa binyuze mubwitange nubufatanye bwa buriwese turashobora gukumira ubushyuhe budasubirwaho, bwihuse hejuru ya 2 ° C.
ws_greenhouse_text: Ni biragoye ndetse uzagororerwa CO2 y'imari, bikaba biteganyijwe ko azatangwa na twebwe abantu mu kirere. Nyamara, imyuka ihumanya ikirere ku isi iriyongera kandi imyuka ya parike mu kirere iriyongera cyane. Bikurikira T r eibhausgase ni kuko isi rwärmung bose bashinzwe . Dioxyde de Carbone CO2, metani CH4 - ikintu 30, okiside ya nitrous N2O - ikintu 300, HFC - inshuro 300.000 )
ws_co2_text: Ubwinshi bwa gaze ya parike mu kirere bimaze kuba hejuru kuburyo impuzandengo ya dogere 1.5 ° C na nyuma yayo izagaragara. A Domino ingaruka (Kwemererwa babibona Ingingo) Dutegerezwa rero, byanze bikunze bituma kuba. Ku bw'ibyo, tugomba cyane gazi bihumanya nk'uko gusa bishoboka kongera mu kirere Pick . Mugutera ibiti, kurema ahantu h'icyatsi nibindi byinshi.
ws_animals_h: U ur inyamaswa, amashyamba mu nyanja kurinda
ws_animals_text: Amoko ari hagati ya 1.000 na 10,000 apfa buri mwaka . 75% by'udukoko dufite amababa twapfuye mu myaka 25 ishize. Usibye gushyuha, aside mu nyanja na CO2 yashonze nikimwe mubibazo bikomeye. Ibi biganisha ku gusenyuka kw'ibinyabuzima byose byo mu nyanja. Niba amashyamba yacu, inyamaswa, ibimera ninyanja bipfuye, ntakizaza natwe kuri twe abantu .
ws_preparing_text: Ubwiyongere bw'ubushyuhe bwo ku isi bugera kuri 1.4 ° C kandi buziyongera kugera kuri 1.5 ° C muri 2029. Niba leta zose hamwe na kimwe muri byo bigira uruhare runini mu kurinda ikirere, dushobora kugabanya ubushyuhe kuri 2 ° C. Ibiza bidukikije, ibura ry’amazi n’amazi no kuzimangana kw amoko biziyongera cyane. Abantu bose bahura nibibazo kurwego rutigeze rubaho.
ws_awareness_text: Kubwamahirwe, abantu bake cyane bazi uburyo umubumbe wacu ari mubi. Ntabwo twese dushaka ejo hazaza heza hamwe n'ababyeyi bacu, abana bacu, abuzukuru bacu, abavandimwe n'inshuti ? Ntidukwiye guseka nabo, kubahobera no kumva tunezerewe ? Tugomba guhindura gusa icyerekezo cyiza. Reka dusangire ubu butumwa nabandi bantu bafite ubutwari, icyizere nurukundo.
